the industry and the ability to pay for labour costs.

salary system.

           financial liability to the gross carrying amount of a financial asset or        量，折現為該金融資產賬面餘額或該
           to the amortized cost of a financial liability. When calculating the            金融負債攤餘成本所使用的利率。在
           effective interest rate, the Group shall estimate the expected cash             確定實際利率時，在考慮金融資產或

           or liabilities (for example, early repayment, extension, call and               展期、看漲期權或其他類似期權等）的

                                                                                           預期信用損失。

           allocated to such performance obligation when a performance                  即在客戶取得相關商品或服務控制權
           obligation is satisfied, i.e. when “control” of the goods or                 時，按照分攤至該項履約義務的交易
           services underlying the particular performance obligation is                 價格確認收入。履約義務，是指合同

           the commitment that a good or service that is distinct shall be              或服務的承諾。交易價格，是指本集

           to the amount of consideration to which the Group expects to                 權收取的對價金額，但不包含代第三
           be entitled in exchange of transferring goods or services to a               方收取的款項以及本集團預期將退還
           customer, excluding the amount received on behalf of third parties           給客戶的款項。
           and the amount that the Group expects to return to a customer.


           On the inception date of the contract, the Group evaluates                   本集團在合同開始日對合同進行評

           performance obligation is performed within a certain period of               一時段內履行，還是在某一時點履
           time or at a certain point in time. It is a performance obligation           行。滿足下列條件之一的，屬於在某
           satisfied during a period of time if one of the following conditions         一時間段內履行的履約義務，本集團

                 solution services contracts. As at 31 December 2025, some                                                                                           度。截至2025年12月31日，本
                 of the Group’s supply chain solution services contracts were                                                                                        集團部分供應鏈解決方案項目尚
                 still in the process of performance, the transaction price                                                                                          在履行過程中，分攤至尚未履行
                 allocated to the outstanding (or partially unperformed)                                                                                         （或部分未履行）履約義務的交易
                 performance obligations is related to the performance                                                                                               價格與相應供應鏈解決方案項目
                 progress of each supply chain solution services contract, and                                                                                       的履約進度相關，並將於相應供
                 will be recognised as revenue in the future performance                                                                                             應鏈解決方案項目的未來履約期

      4.     Capital management                                                        4.   資本管理
             The key objectives of the Group’s capital management are to                    本集團資本管理的主要目標是確保本
